notes.title: Be The First To Enter The Void!
notes.content:
[h2]🚀 The Alpha is Almost Here![/h2][p]We’ll be inviting players to the upcoming playtest very soon, and everyone on our mailing list will get [b]first access[/b]. Don’t miss out, be among the first to jump in and help shape the game![/p][p]
[url="https://www.forkinthecodestudios.com/" style="button"]Sign up here![/url][/p][p][/p][h2]What is the Alpha?[/h2][p]The Alpha is a small peek at what we’ve been building—a limited version of the game designed to gather your feedback and refine the experience.[/p][p]This is just the first step! A larger, more in-depth open demo will follow once we’ve incorporated what we learn from this early playtest.[/p]
